18 May 2017 Jamb Results Are Out - Check Now by samexycool(op): 11:51pm On May 21, 2017
JAMB RESULTS for candidates who wrote the examination on the 18 of may 2017 are out and is available online on the jamb portal.

Candidates who wrote the Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination UTME on that the are hereby instructed to go to the JAMB results checking portal and check for their Jamb score.

Note: CHECKING OF JAMB RESULTS is free online.

If you check and see no result yet. Just be patient and check back within the next 24 hrs. Need help on how to check your JAMB results....followed the link below;
